_about: Public-domain Hans Lassen Martensen (1808-1884, Bishop of Zealand) in English for the Word Hoard: Christian Dogmatics, tr. William Urwick (1866), the three parts of Christian Ethics, tr. C. Spence, William Affleck and Sophia Taylor (1881-1885), and Jacob Boehme, tr. T. Rhys Evans (1885), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

martensen-christian-dogmatics: Christian Dogmatics, tr. William Urwick (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXVI)
martensen-ethics-general: Christian Ethics, General Part, tr. C. Spence (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXXXV)
martensen-ethics-individual: Christian Ethics, Special Part, first division: Individual Ethics, tr. William Affleck (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1881)
martensen-ethics-social: Christian Ethics, Special Part, second division: Social Ethics, tr. Sophia Taylor (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1882)
martensen-jacob-boehme: Jacob Boehme: his Life and Teaching, or Studies in Theosophy, tr. T. Rhys Evans (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCLXXXV)

_alternates.martensen-copies: Dogmatics (other 1866 copies); General Part (1888, 1891); Individual Ethics fourth edition (1891); Boehme (another 1885 copy)

_excluded.martensen-late: 1949 Boehme reprints; the German Meister Eckart (PG 77203)
